{{Short description| Indian professor and politician}}
'''Aiyub Khan '''(born on 1 July 1967) is a [[professor]] of [[mathematics]] in [[Jai Narain Vyas University]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dr. Ayub Khan |url=https://www.jnvu.co.in/teams/dr-ayub-khan/ |access-date=2023-12-20 |website=Jai Narain Vyas University |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Aiyub Khan research |url=https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/Shaista-Shaikh-77405793}}</ref> and politician in [[Rajasthan]] from [[Indian national congress]]  <ref>{{Cite web |date=2018-11-30 |title=सूरसागर विस क्षेत्र में गणित बिठाने में लगे हैं प्रो खान तो हिंदुत्व पर सवार होकर प्रचार में लगी है जीजी, जाने प्रत्याशियों का हाल {{!}} soorsagar assembly area candidates prof ayub khan and suryakanta vyas |url=https://www.patrika.com/jodhpur-news/soorsagar-assembly-area-candidates-prof-ayub-khan-and-suryakanta-vyas-3779183/ |access-date=2023-12-20 |website=Patrika News |language=hi-IN}}</ref> of Soorsagar constituency [[Jodhpur]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Professor Ayyub Khan(Indian National Congress(INC)):Constituency- SOORSAGAR(JODHPUR) - Affidavit Information of Candidate: |url=https://www.myneta.info/rajasthan2018/candidate.php?candidate_id=4369 |access-date=2023-12-20 |website=www.myneta.info}}</ref> candidate in 2018. Khan is member of [[Rajasthan Public Service Commission]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=RPSC {{!}} Organization |url=https://rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in/commission |access-date=2023-12-20 |website=rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=आरपीएससी सदस्य बनने के बाद प्रो अयूब खान का जोरदार स्वागत, कहा-रात दो बजे आया था कॉल |url=https://www.etvbharat.com/hindi/rajasthan/state/jodhpur/prof-ayub-khan-welcomed-in-jodhpur-after-appointed-rpsc-member/rj20231010213448805805867 |access-date=2023-12-20 |website=ETV Bharat News |language=hi}}</ref>

==Education==
Khan did his education in [[Jai Narain Vyas University]], he did [[PhD]] under supervision of [[Prem Kumar Bhatia]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Aiyub Khan paper |url=https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/P-K-Bhatia-2084411234}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Thermal Science - scientific journal [author: Aiyub Khan] |url=https://thermalscience.vinca.rs/authors/528 |access-date=2023-12-21 |website=thermalscience.vinca.rs}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Khan |first=Aiyub |last2=Tak |first2=S. S. |last3=Patni |first3=Priy Adarshi |date=2011 |title=Effects of Hall currents on Jeans gravitational instability of rotating unbounded plasma |url=https://inis.iaea.org/search/search.aspx?orig_q=RN:44059707 |journal=Romanian Journal of Physics |language=English |volume=56 |issue=1-2 |issn=1221-146X}}</ref> in 1993. Khan is [[Fellow]] of [[Royal Astronomical Society]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Aiyub Khan FRAS |url=https://ras.ac.uk/sites/default/files/images/stories/Council/Minutes%20December%202011.pdf}}</ref>

==Career==
Khan worked in SD PG college, Sriganganagar before joining [[Jai Narain Vyas University]] . Presently he is active in politics and also member of [[Rajasthan Public Service Commission]], under his supervision 4 students have done PhD. Khan is member of nine professional academies . Khan is member of Academic council of [[Jai Narain Vyas University]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Academic council |url=https://www.jnvu.co.in/academic-council/ |access-date=2023-12-20 |website=Jai Narain Vyas University |language=en-US}}</ref>
